mentions.name: agent-horde
mentions.description: A pi extension for running agent swarms. Paired with DeepSeek it performs well on various research tasks, and after every run it generates a postmortem that the author uses to iterate on the swarm protocol ("poor man's RSI").
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a pi extension for running agent swarms. Paired with deepseek, this has been performing really well for various research tasks.
